8872 Servohydraulic Fatigue Testing System
Product catalog summary
Overview: The Instron® 8872 is a compact tabletop servohydraulic testing system designed for static and dynamic testing of various materials and components, including medical devices and biomaterials. It features a double-acting servohydraulic actuator with a force capacity of up to ±25 kN and a high-stiffness load frame.
Key Features:
Force capacity up to ±25 kN with a precision-aligned load frame.
100 mm usable stroke for dynamic and static testing.
Adjustable upper crosshead with hydraulic lifts and manual locks.
Patented Dynacell™ load cell technology for faster testing and reduced inertial errors.
Compact design requiring less than 0.4 m² of space.
Optional hydrostatic bearing actuators for higher side-load resistance.
Compatible with the 3520 Series of Hydraulic Power Units and a wide range of accessories.
Controller and Software: The system includes a digital 8800 controller with features like automatic loop tuning, amplitude control, and adaptive control technology. It supports WaveMatrix™ Dynamic Testing Software and Bluehill® Software for static tests.
Testing Applications:
Fatigue Testing: Utilizes mechanical or hydraulic grips and dynamic extensometers for high-frequency fatigue testing.
Fracture Mechanics: Configurable with CT grips and sensors for crack growth studies.
Component Testing: Suitable for evaluating fatigue in components like engine mounts.
Environmental Testing: Capable of testing at various temperatures using environmental chambers.
Medical Device Testing: Tests devices like orthopedic implants in air or fluid baths at body temperature.
Specifications:
Dimensions: Standard and extra height frame options available.
Dynamic Load Capacity: Up to ±25 kN.
Actuator Stroke: 100 mm total.
Frame Stiffness: 260 kN/mm.
Operating Environment: +10 to +38°C with 10 to 90% humidity.
Electrical Supply: Single-phase mains with power consumption up to 800 VA.
Accessories: Includes various grips, fixtures, and attachment kits for specific testing needs.

Catalog excerpts
8872 Servohydraulic Fatigue Testing System Up to 25 kN The Instron® 8872 is a compact tabletop servohydraulic testing system that meets the challenging demands of various static and dynamic testing requirements. With the actuator in the upper crosshead and a lower t-slot table, the 8872 makes an ideal platform for a variety of medical devices, biomaterials, advanced materials, and other component testing.
Features • Double-acting servohydraulic actuator with force capacity up to ±25 kN (±5620 lbf) • High-stiffness, precision-aligned load frame with twin columns and actuator in upper crosshead • 100 mm (4 in) of usable stroke • Designed for both dynamic and static testing on a variety of materials and components • Choice of hydraulic configuration and dynamic performance to suit application • Extra-height frame option for testing longer load strings • Adjustable upper crosshead with hydraulic lifts and manual locks fitted as standard for easy adjustment of daylight
• Patented1 Dynacell™ load cell technology for faster testing and reduction of inertial errors • Compact tabletop servohydraulic fatigue testing system – frame requires less than 0.4 m² (4.3 ft²) of space • Optional hydrostatic bearing actuators for higher side-load resistance or material critical applications, such as low-cycle fatigue • Designed to be used with the 3520 Series of Hydraulic Power Units • Compatible with a large range of grips, fixtures, chambers, video extensometers, protective shields, and other accessories
Controller and Software The Instron 8872 is supplied with a digital 8800 controller that provides full system control including features such as automatic loop tuning, amplitude control, specimen protect, 19-bit resolution across the full range of transducers, and adaptive control technology. It also allows access to WaveMatrix™ Dynamic Testing Software, Bluehill® Software for static tests and other application specific software, such as the Low Cycle Fatigue or Fracture Mechanics suite. Open the catalog to page 1
Typical Testing Applications A wide range of system options, grips, fixtures, and accessories allow the Instron® 8872 to be customized for specific applications. Whether your application demands low or high temperatures, fluid immersion, or complex specimen gripping geometry, Instron offers a complete tailored solution.
Fatigue Testing Mechanical or hydraulic wedge-action or collet grips, compression platens, and dynamic extensometers allow for high-frequency fatigue testing of various specimens.
